title: Pricing & Packaging Transition: Comms Plan, Release Notes, and Sales Enablement Assets
creator: Leah Park
description: Scope: Coordinate cross-functional launch of new pricing SKUs, quota/limits changes, and billing communication. Deliverables include finalized SKU mapping, release notes copy, customer billing migration comms, console in-product messaging, Sales enablement playbook, and Support runbook. This ticket orchestrates sequencing, approvals, and asset handoff between PM, Billing/Finance, Docs, Console, Legal, Sales, and Support. Goal is a staged rollout with pilot customers followed by GA, minimizing billing friction and ensuring Sales and Support are ready to handle inquiries.
success_criteria: SKU mappings published to billing-service and docs before GA
Release notes and Help Center article live on release day
Sales enablement deck + objection handling scripts delivered and scheduled training completed
Automated billing migration script tested on staging with 0 data loss
Console banners and admin messaging QA'd in all regions
Support triage playbook published and Support SLA maintained
acceptance_criteria: All cross-team approvals recorded (Finance, Legal, Billing, Security)
Release notes signed off by Communications and PM
Billing test cases pass in staging and UAT
Sales training scheduled and at least 3 sessions completed prior to GA
Migration rollback plan documented and reviewed
tasks: Finalize SKU list and canonical pricing table (owner: Billing)
Update billing-service price IDs and limit enforcement (owner: ENG-Billing)
Prepare release notes draft and changelog entries (owner: Docs)
Draft customer migration email series and in-console notification copy (owner: PM)
Create Sales enablement deck, objection handling, and ROI calculator (owner: Sales Enablement)
Build support triage checklist and internal KB (owner: Support)
QA Console banner, admin panel labels, and usage meter UX (owner: Console UX)
Coordinate legal review for contract language/terms (owner: Legal)
Run billing migration dry-run on staging; record anomalies (owner: Billing + SRE)
Publish final Help Center article and link from release notes (owner: Docs)
Schedule cross-functional cutover call for GA day and post-mortem (owner: PM)
release_notes_outline: Headline: Streamlined SKUs for clearer billing and more predictable costs
Summary: We’re simplifying pricing to align unit economics across workloads; some customers will see new SKU IDs and adjusted quota thresholds. No immediate charge changes for free-tier customers.
Key changes: New SKU mapping table, updated per-minute/per-token billing for embeddings and generation, quota consolidation for low-usage SKUs
Action for customers: Review migration email, check Admin Console banner for org-specific timeline, contact Support for billing questions
Rollout plan: Pilot customers (two-week window) -> opt-in -> GA with automated migration and 14-day rollback window
